purpose: Post-hoc replay after analyzing 100 Sep2 discovery trades; measures whether identified failure controls reduce damage. Not validation.

rules.profit_target: 0.33% or 0.44% gross; normal positive exit below 3x fee is avoided

notes: Sequential trades use one evolving $100 account. If sequential timing cannot naturally reach 100, remaining items are explicitly marked independent diagnostic probes and are NOT included in sequential final equity.
Historical full L2 unavailable; Binance 1m taker-buy delta is an aggressor-flow proxy.
Highly in-sample: these rules were designed after inspecting Sep2 Discovery100. Improvement cannot be treated as out-of-sample edge.
learned_changes: Quarantine SWEEP_RECLAIM and PULLBACK_RELOAD after 5.9% and 7.7% win rates in raw Discovery100.
Minimum structural stop raised to 0.16% to avoid friction-scale stops.
Early no-follow-through and weak-progress loss exits added.
After price has traded >=0.33% favorable (3x modeled fee), a giveback protection state is activated.
